name: Maya R.
profile: I live in a one-bedroom apartment downtown (third floor, elevator). I work from home three days a week and I'm away about 9 hours the other two. No kids. I have one 12-year-old cat who is easily stressed. I've never owned a dog before. I'm fairly active - I walk 30-45 minutes a day and would like a companion for weekend hikes.

name: The Okafor family
profile: We live in a house with a fully fenced backyard. Two kids, ages 5 and 8. Both parents work 8-5 and a neighbor's teenager can walk a dog at lunchtime, so a dog would be alone about 4 hours at a stretch. We had a Labrador for 11 years who passed away last spring, so we know the commitment. We're very active on weekends (hiking, soccer, beach trips). No other pets.

name: Dan T.
profile: I'm retired and live alone in a small house with a quiet street and a small yard. I'm home almost all day. No children visit except my grandkids (ages 12 and 14) a few times a year. I've had dogs and cats all my life, most recently two senior dogs. I prefer a calm companion over an athlete: short walks, lots of couch time. Happy to take on grooming or minor medical needs.

name: Priya & Sam
profile: We rent a studio apartment (pets allowed, 25 lb weight limit). We both travel for work roughly two weeks every month and would use a pet sitter or boarding. We've never had a pet. We love running (5 miles most mornings) and want a dog that can keep up. No kids, no other pets. We work from home when we're not traveling.
